summary: The plan has been reshaped three times by its own task-contract reads, and this record describes its CURRENT shape. T1 shipped as one condition in the grill recorder. T2 shipped as one collapsed ledger view after its reads cut an escalation grant (split to T5, whose scoping does not exist) and an outcome field (deferred as D-0032, because the companion is invoked with --json so the griller's verdict marker never ends stdout). T3's read then showed the story's central design was larger than its evidence: the measured cascade was requirements_digest taking the bare default exclusion while every other closeout check calls product_excluded_prefixes, the documented ONE definition of not-product. The full input manifest is deferred as D-0035 and the confirmed spec is amended to match. The owner reversed an earlier ruling so a newly accepted decision no longer stales the requirements gate, and split the story from four tasks to five.
gaps: The plan described a manifest across all six gates while the measured cost came from one gate taking a different exclusion list than every other check.
The four-task graph was settled by an earlier round, but T2's read split out a fifth task with no recorded replacement.
contradictions: The plan required every accepted decision to stale a pass, which fired circularly on this very story: recording decision 0067 invalidated the requirements gate that had already read the spec 0067 came from.

The plan's Technical Approach still specified manifest mechanics — set comparison, the optional schema field, derived manifests — after the T3 bullet had been narrowed, so the plan contradicted itself.
resolutions: T3 narrows to passing product_excluded_prefixes inside requirements_digest, with one freshness helper that also accepts the legacy digest so existing passes are not reinterpreted as stale.
The full manifest, the shared predicate across six gates and the bounded command-grammar check are deferred as D-0035 with a revisit trigger.
The owner reversed the decision-staleness ruling for the requirements gate on 2026-09-13; the reversal is recorded in the plan's owner rulings and the confirmed spec is amended.
The five-task graph is recorded as an explicit supersession of the four-task answer, with the reason: T2's read showed the escalation grant rested on scoping the repo does not have.
The Technical Approach, acceptance summary, risks, verify plan, task order and T4's dependency were all reconciled to the current shape.
